text:
maria: quick heads-up — planning to push an annotated tag and create the GH draft for v1.12.0 today before 18:00 PT. Can someone own artifact checksum + attach to the draft? release window ~3h.
alex: I can take checksum + S3 upload. Which paths?
maria: artifacts are at s3://redwood-release/1.12.0/ — linux.tar.gz, wheel, and linux-musl tar. Need sha256 for each and include hashes in the draft body. Also annotate the tag with a changelog link: ./CHANGELOG.md#v1.12.0
sophie: tagging command I'll run (annotated):
```bash
git tag -a v1.12.0 -m "Release v1.12.0"
git push origin refs/tags/v1.12.0
```
jamal: I can create the draft release on GH and add notes. Please don't publish until canary smoke checks pass. I'll wait for the checksums/attachments from @alex.
release-bot: build pipeline completed: build-1.12.0-linux, build-1.12.0-wheel uploaded to staging.
alex: uploading to s3 now... done. sha256s:
- linux.tar.gz: 3b7f4c8d9a1e2f5c6d8e9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0
- wheel.whl: a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0
- linux-musl.tar.gz: 9f8e7d6c5b4a39281716253445566778899aabbccddeeff0011223344556677
maria: thanks. @jamal once the draft is created, set it as draft=true and don't hit publish. Also reminder: cutoff for package index sync is 21:00 PT tonight — if anything lands after that, it will miss the sync.
sophie: any cherrypicks needed into release branch? I have a tiny docs fix if it's safe to include.
alex: no functional cherrypicks pending AFAIK, docs ok to include.
jamal: draft created: https://github.com/redwood/repo/releases/draft/12345 — attached artifacts and pasted sha256s into the body. Notes include the changelog link and a short migration note. Draft status = true, not publishing.
maria: perfect. I'll run the preflight smoke in the prod-replica at 20:00 PT and report back. If all green we'll publish after the 21:00 cutoff window. :shipit: 
ci-bot: preflight job queued (job id 6789) — will post results to this thread when complete.
